head: 33ad6f7561f67e71bfd8c4c10ae6e2df7e750701
summary:
The defect that sent attempt 1 back is fixed. Since f9c303e (the commit attempt 1 validated) the only content change is eng/rules-harness/plants.json: the anchors of F36–F40 and P28–P31 are now the full text of WindowReport.cs:276. No src, tests, fitness.yaml or other eng file changed (git diff --name-only f9c303e HEAD).

**Rules harness (Q-027).** I ran it on the real plants.json, not a copy, using the engine interpreter:
- Exit 0 in 26 s: 102 rows, 102 AS-RECORDED, 0 not, 0 stray hits.
- F36–F40 fire in both xUnit and Fitness, and P28–P31 stay quiet in both, so the rule's fire and quiet cases from O-021 are now actually tested.
- Its scratch folder was removed.
- The harness's standing NOT RUN for the one import rule (its scratch copy has no code graph) is unchanged.

**Other checks run here.**
- rules-parity reports AGREE (16 facts, 20 twinned entries, 40 patterns) under both powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7.
- The engine's Fitness check passes: 82 rules hold.
- The whole default suite builds and passes 559/562. The 3 failures are the same last-access back-dating tests that build-check recorded at afd021d before any SL-089 work (Q-190).
- Nothing was left behind: only the person's own Z: mapping, no app, rig, provider or consent process, and git status unchanged.

**Criteria rest on attempt 1's runs.** As the send-back directed, I did not re-run attempt 1's real-contact cases. They ran at f9c303e, and every file they read is unchanged since:
- N-005 and N-006 (criterion 1, cloud half met under Q-177)
- T-009 (criterion 2)
- R-002 steps f and g (criterion 4)
- W-001 on three bounded roots and C-013
- WindowMutants (11/11 killed)

Because of that, this attempt's own contact is `code`. Criterion 3 at whole-C:\ scale is still the person's run.

**Loop check.** Build attempts 3–5 all came from code-review revokes, and 4–5 changed no src. Each closed a different defect (the O-034 class, then the plant anchors), and the slice was planned to change no src, so this is progress, not a loop.

**Filed to the backlog (extra).** The `_note` in plants.json still says no harness run has recorded SL-089's rows. That is now false.

checks.what: W-001 over the whole of C:\ (criterion 3 as stated)
checks.evidence: A whole-drive scan is the person's to give on this machine. SL-095 measured about 537 MB of kernel pool for a cold C: scan, past the engine's 0.5 GB per-run guard, and review M8 / O-025 make it the owner's run. The same pipeline held on three bounded real roots in attempt 1.

criteria.criterion: 1. Stop on the stalled SMB share; s, the folder being listed, is then released by tearing the share down, so its listing ends in a network error
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1's real run at f9c303e; every file N-005 reads is unchanged since. N-005 main run: no row for s. Its no-Stop control (teardown 8021 ms after the hold, main run 8025 ms) put s in as NothingListed 59.

criteria.criterion: 2. Stop on either rig; t and u are first opened after Stop or never, and fail once the share is gone or the provider fails fetches
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, inputs unchanged. N-005: t and u were never opened after Stop and have no row; the control lit both with code 53. N-006: no row, and no cloud ending lights them without Stop either, so on the cloud rig this is the Q-177 platform limit.

criteria.criterion: 3. Stop on either rig; a (refused at open) and b (failed partway) both finished before Stop
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, inputs unchanged. In N-005 and N-006, a is NothingListed 5 and b is ListedPartway 59, each once. Header = core.unreadable = dump rows = 2. The failpoint fired on b page 3 before Stop.

criteria.criterion: 4. Stop on the hung cloud rig; s's FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS is pending at Stop, then the provider completes it with a failure status
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, inputs unchanged. N-006: no row for s under Stop. The release, kill and timeout controls also gave no row (711 files, 5 folders, 71,100 bytes). Met under Q-177's decided negative branch, recorded as a platform limit.

criteria.criterion: 5. Held folder: keep-last-access open refused (5), plain open gets a sharing violation (32)
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1: T-009 probed h 5/32, and its row reads 'could not be opened: in use by another program', with no 'access denied'. Re-checked here: HeldFolderReasonTests passes in this run's default suite (559/562; it is not among the 3 failures).

criteria.criterion: 6. Keep-last-access open refused, nobody holds the folder, so the plain open lists it in full (c)
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1: in T-009, c probed 5/0, has no row, and core.unreadable is 1. HeldFolderReasonTests asserts c is listed and passed here.

criteria.criterion: 7. On the SMB rig, b's listing fails on page 3 with Win32 59 after two real pages
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1: in N-005 the failpoint fired on b page 3 over SMB, and the row reads ListedPartway 59, 'only partly read: network or share error'. The code is injected client-side, as designed.

criteria.criterion: 8. Whole C:\ scan: the published exe runs non-elevated with several hundred rows, most never realised
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, on a bounded real root: W-001 on WER gave 446 rows = header = core.unreadable, 7 realised, elevated false. Whole-C:\ scale is planned item 3, person-run.

criteria.criterion: 9. Whole C:\ scan: a folder whose keep-last-access open was refused and which was then listed in full (~306,000 on this PC)
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, on bounded roots. W-001 on C:\Windows\Logs\ found 1 row, still refused. On WER all 446 rows were reopened and still refused. The checker controls held. The ~306,000 scale needs the person's C:\ run. W001OracleTests passed in this run's suite.

criteria.criterion: 10. Whole C:\ scan: rows left over from the CfProvider rig (code 363 or REPARSE, about 30)
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1: W-001 on fsa-guard-tests gave 27 code-363 rows, tallied as leftovers, with non-empty reasons. Corpus rows F11–F13 passed in this run's W001OracleTests.

criteria.criterion: 11. Whole C:\ scan: a code-2 row whose folder was deleted during the scan and since recreated
criteria.how: Code contact only. Corpus rows F08 and F04 in W001OracleTests use real folders and passed in this run's suite. Such a row cannot be produced on demand on a live drive.

criteria.criterion: 12. Show in Explorer from a panel row: denied folder at about 300 characters
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, inputs unchanged. R-002 step f: Exact, hr 0, landed in 389 ms. The window's Name is the parent's and the single selection's Name is the leaf. No dialog, no consent.exe.

criteria.criterion: 13. Show in Explorer from a panel row: denied folder at about 1000 characters
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1. R-002 step g: Exact, hr 0, landed in 770 ms, with the same Name-only checks. The menu is labelled 'Open in Explorer', a design decision.

criteria.criterion: 14. Show in Explorer from a panel row: the denied folder is hidden or system
criteria.how: The design marks this shape non-material, with no test owed. R-002 asserts the fixture is neither hidden nor system. Selecting hidden or system items belongs to Q-175's follow-on slice.

planned.evidence: From attempt 1's real runs on the published exe at f9c303e; every input is unchanged since, and the only later change is plants.json anchors. N-005 (SMB loopback) and N-006 (real cldflt root): after Stop only a and b are rows, once each. s, t and u have no row. The SMB control lit s (59) and t/u (53); the cloud controls lit nothing, recorded under Q-177. Rows were read through the hook dump and cross-checked against the schema-1 header and core.unreadable.

From attempt 1: T-009 h (5/32) reads 'could not be opened: in use by another program', with no 'access denied'. N-005 b reads 'only partly read: network or share error' (59). HeldFolderReasonTests passed again in this run's default suite.

From attempt 1: R-002 steps f (300 characters) and g (1000 characters) invoked the panel row's Explorer action. Both landed on the parent with only the leaf selected, checked by Name through Shell.Application, in 389 and 770 ms, hr 0, with no dialog and no consent.exe. Inputs are unchanged since.

obligations.evidence: Its fix names plants F36–F40 (must fire) and P28–P31 (must stay quiet). Until this build those rows were PLANT-BROKEN and never judged. This run of the harness on the real plants.json judged all nine AS-RECORDED, fire/fire and quiet/quiet in both engines, exit 0, 102/102.

not_reached: The whole-C:\ W-001 run (criterion 3 at full scale: hundreds of rows, ~306,000 refused-then-listed folders) is a person's to run, because SL-095 measured ~537 MB of kernel pool for a cold C: scan, past the engine's 0.5 GB guard.
This attempt re-ran no real-contact case. The N-005, N-006, T-009, R-002 and W-001 results are attempt 1's at f9c303e, carried because nothing they read changed.
No real remote SMB server or real network drop: the SMB half used the 127.0.0.1 SMBLibrary rig, and b's code 59 is injected by the client-side listing failpoint.
No real cloud provider (OneDrive): the Q-177 platform limit is measured only against tests/CfProvider's three endings on a real cldflt root.
Windows 10 (Q-192): every case ran on Windows 11 26200.
No panel-row reveal on a volume without 8.3 names (D:), and no hidden or system targets under Explorer's default Hidden=2 (Q-175's follow-on slice).
